name: Dodo Payments API
tagline: Work with payments, subscriptions, customers, products, refunds and licenses in Dodo Payments
description: Official remote MCP server for the Dodo Payments API. Cline can query and manage your Dodo Payments account in test or live mode: payments, subscriptions, customers, products, refunds, license keys and usage-based billing. Sign-in is OAuth in the browser on first use (choose test or live mode and approve), so no API key is stored in your Cline config.
